returns.name: Employer's quarterly wage report and tax payment (UTS)
contents: Number of employees, both full- and part-time, employed in the months covered by the wage report
Texas county where the greatest number of your employees worked
Number of employees who worked outside the county reported above
A Social Security number for each employee unique to that quarterly wage report
Each employee's last name and first initial (the middle initial is optional)
Texas wages paid to each employee for the quarter
Wages paid to each employee and reported to a state other than Texas, if applicable

notModelled: The wage-report upload layout for more than 1,000 employees (TWC QuickFile) was not read.
Texas legal holidays were not read.
The tax rate notice is an input; the 2026 minimum is 0.32% and maximum 6.32% (S1).

channels.description: Unemployment Tax Services (UTS): file wage reports for 1,000 or fewer employees and pay by ACH debit or credit card. QuickFile is TWC's free software for more than 1,000 employees.
enrollment: Register for a new tax account on Unemployment Tax Registration (UTR); wait for the Employer Liability Notice before accessing the account; the same user ID and password work for UTR and UTS.
